title: Bad Glaze
text: Bad Glaze. I rather thought that this being Lennox and made here in the USA that it would be a better quality. I have done ceramic work for most of my life and this piece is very obviously over glazed. So much so that the decal work is fuzzy and not very distinct. The leaf pattern is almost non existent. Nice enough to use as a watering can I suppose. Overall I'm not that excited about it.

product_metadata.title: Lenox Butterfly Meadow Figural Frog Pitcher, Multicolor
description: The delicate design of Butterfly Meadow dinnerware is incorporated into the whimsical Butterfly Meadow Figural Frog Pitcher. Crafted in shimmering white porcelain and decorated with a bright blue butterfly, this lovely frog pitcher may not turn into a prince, but will bring real charm and a beverage, right to your kitchen and dinner table. Makes a wonderful gift.
